issues: 26058, 26066–26072: “weekdays, including Saturdays” conflicts with ordinary English usage, where weekdays normally means Monday–Friday. issues: 26058, 26066–26072: “días laborables” can be understood as excluding Saturday in Latin American usage, so it does not reliably convey the Italian feriali or the explicit Monday–Saturday excluding holidays in the Chinese draft. Specify lunes a sábado salvo festivos. In 26066, “días festivos, no laborables” is also ambiguous as to whether no laborables describes festivos or contrasts with them.
